# 获取未平仓合约数

- **GET** `/capi/v3/market/openInterest`

权重(IP): 2

**请求参数**

| 参数名 | 类型 | 是否必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| symbol | String | 是 | 交易对 |

**请求示例**

```
curl "https://api-contract.weex.com/capi/v3/market/openInterest?symbol=BTCUSDT"
```

**返回参数**

| 参数名 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| symbol | String | 交易对 |
| openInterest | String | 当前未平仓合约数量 |
| time | Long | 撮合引擎时间戳 Unix 毫秒时间戳 |

**返回示例**

```
{
  "symbol": "BTCUSDT",
  "openInterest": "128345.67",
  "time": 1764505777345
}
```
